card.text: Explore Styx through a clearly labeled approximate shape fit.

introduction.text: Styx is the innermost of Pluto’s four small moons. New Horizons revealed an elongated body, but too little surface detail for a map.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: Shape estimated from New Horizons images that resolve only a few pixels. The pole is uncertain; gray grid: no imagery.
